subtasks.title: Extract requirements and constraints
subtasks.instruction: Extract exact architecture/user requirements, acceptance, dependencies, non-goals and compatibility obligations; list open decisions.
subtasks.deliverable: Requirements-to-acceptance traceability table.
subtasks.done_when: Every acceptance clause and dependency is represented.

subtasks.title: Define interfaces and data contracts
subtasks.instruction: Define typed interfaces, data ownership, schema/API/event shapes, state transitions and compatibility behavior.
subtasks.deliverable: Interface/schema/sequence specification with versioning and ownership.
subtasks.done_when: Contracts are deterministic, testable and match the ten-module architecture.

subtasks.title: Define safety and failure behavior
subtasks.instruction: Specify permissions, privacy/secrets, failure modes, retry/backpressure, idempotency, rollback and STOP behavior.
subtasks.deliverable: Threat/failure matrix and rollback notes.
subtasks.done_when: No implicit privilege expansion; failures are explicit and fail-closed.

subtasks.title: Map acceptance to tests
subtasks.instruction: Map each acceptance clause to unit/integration/negative/host tests, expected outputs and fixtures.
subtasks.deliverable: Acceptance test matrix and commands/fixtures plan.
subtasks.done_when: Every clause has a test or explicit manual gate.

subtasks.title: Review implementation design
subtasks.instruction: Cross-check design against module contracts, AGENTS.md, SECURITY.md and CODING_HANDBOOK.md; resolve contradictions before coding.
subtasks.deliverable: Reviewed implementation plan and allowed-path proposal.
subtasks.done_when: No unresolved architecture/security conflict; Supervisor approves scope.

parents.completion_rule: Complete all child steps; satisfy owner gate if present; pass independent QC bound to candidate SHA; pass serialized merge. Only then mark parent completed.
